_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent VLC-ISAC paper! m-CAP modulation + RSS trilateration for joint communication and indoor positioning. IEEE TBC journal. 32 Mbps + 7.17 cm error.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: System architecture with 9 APs, m-CAP mod/demod. Fig.2: MAC cycle with location frames. Fig.3: Illuminance map (300-500 lux). Fig.5: RMS positioning error distribution. Fig.6: CDF of error (7.17 cm @90%). Fig.8-9: BER vs roll-off analysis.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: VLC-ISAC using m-CAP modulation and RSS-based trilateration. 9 white LED APs in 4m×4m room. Sensing via RSS (received signal strength) from 4 closest APs. Communication: m-CAP with 4/8 sub-bands, 16-256 QAM. Single PD receiver at UE.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 32 Mbps (256-QAM, 8 sub-bands). BER < 3.8e-3 (FEC limit). Sensing: 7.17 cm RMS error @90% (with DC), 5.34 cm @66%. Illuminance: 300-500 lux. SNR: 43-50 dB. Room: 4m×4m×2.5m, h=1.65m.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: First m-CAP + RSS-trilateration VLC-ISAC system with realistic LED constraints. Takes into account lighting standards (EN 12464-1) and LED bandwidth limitations (3 MHz). Gap: Alternative modulations (OFDM, FBMC) perform differently. Roll-off/filter trade-offs analyzed.

bibliographic.title: Joint Visible Light Sensing and Communication Using m-CAP Modulation
bibliographic.authors: Lina Shi, Bastien Béchadergue, Luc Chassagne, Hongyu Guan

application.scenario_description: Indoor VLC-ISAC system for office environments: simultaneous data communication and positioning using white LED lighting infrastructure.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First VLC-ISAC system combining m-CAP modulation with RSS-based trilateration, incorporating realistic LED bandwidth and lighting constraints (EN 12464-1).
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous VLC-ISAC works ignored LED dynamic range limits and lighting standards, leading to unrealistic performance claims.

transmitter.notes: 4× LUXEON Rebel white LED chips per AP. 880 lm total. 2.84 W optical power. 3 MHz LED bandwidth. Bias: 2.8 A. Linear region: 1.6-4 A.

receiver.notes: 4× Hamamatsu S6967 PDs. Responsivity 0.63 A/W. FOV 85°. Effective area 105.6 mm². No optical filter/concentrator.

integration.notes: MAC cycle: common preamble → sequential location frames (sensing) → payload (comm). RSS uses variance of received signal.

waveform.notes: m-CAP: 4 or 8 sub-bands. Sub-band width: 1 MHz or 0.5 MHz. Roll-off 0.4. Filter length 10. Same waveform for comm and RSS sensing.

channel_wireless.notes: 4m×4m×2.5m room. UE at 85 cm height (h=1.65 m). 9 APs on ceiling. LOS channel only. Semi-angle 30°.

comm_metrics.notes: 32 Mbps max (256-QAM, 8 sub-bands). BER below FEC limit (7% OH) everywhere. SNR varies 32-50 dB depending on position.

sensing_metrics.notes: RSS-trilateration using 4 closest APs. 7.17 cm RMS error @90% (with DC). 5.34 cm @66%. Degrades to 64.81 cm without DC.

tradeoff.notes: Higher QAM order (M=256) shrinks coverage area, reducing sensing availability. Roll-off affects comm BER more than positioning. Interdependence studied.
